description:
Update the existing CRM opportunity 'Office Furniture - Deco Addict' which is currently displayed in the browser. The opportunity currently has Expected Revenue of $25,000, Probability of 20%, normal priority (0 stars), and no tags.

Make the following changes:
1. Change the Expected Revenue to $75,000
2. Change the Probability to 60%
3. Set the Priority to 2 stars (High) using the star rating widget near the opportunity title
4. Add the tag 'Enterprise' to the Tags field (this tag already exists in the system)
5. Save the record

All four changes must be saved to the database.
